fact: Implementer is the subagent responsible for modifying the project and returning a candidate commit.
One persistent Pi subagent runs the Implement stage, including its measurements, verification, and review rework.
At Verify handoff, the implementation runtime requires at least one successful command whose before and after revisions match the same clean candidate commit.
The implementer chooses names and local implementation details within the approved plan. It sends design or scope questions to the lead designer.
After the lead approves rework, the original implementer revises and verifies the candidate.
